evidence.capture_object: the function entries named src-<tool> in the tools array of the chat/completions request body the Copilot runtime sent the session's BYOK provider
evidence.protocol_version_evidence: the initialize result, or the revision stamped on each request after a successful server/discover, in the JSON-RPC frames session.rpc.diagnostics.read returns at trace level
evidence.limitation: The provider is a BYOK OpenAI-compatible endpoint answered in-process by the request handler; a GitHub-hosted model was not used. The request also carries the runtime's built-in tools, which are not recorded. Retained annotations come from a second turn in which the stub model calls every tool and every approval request is refused.

result_boundaries.label: Agent tool loop (next provider request)
result_boundaries.capture_object: the tool message, and any message the runtime adds for the same result, in the chat/completions request that follows the model's tool call
result_boundaries.limitation: The stub model asks for one tool call. The chat/completions wire format has no tool-error flag, so an error reaches the model as text only. The model is declared vision-capable (SessionConfig.modelCapabilities), as gpt-4.1 is; images ride a user message the runtime appends, whose framing text is not recorded.

result_boundaries.label: Direct tool invocation
result_boundaries.capture_object: the ToolResult the runtime returns, outside a model turn
